timing_scope: Resident-array CPU→GPU pipeline wall times include expansion, packing, queueing, transfers, GPU execution and CPU fallback. Checkpoint preparation, archive I/O and table/array setup are excluded from trials and recorded separately. N72 target runs are sampled work packages.
kernel_seconds_note: GPU kernel seconds sum CUDA stream event intervals. Concurrent streams overlap, so these totals are not GPU busy wall time.
comparison_note: Speedup and CPU ratios are paired by repetition against full within each run. Different policies intentionally have different work and checksums. Runs with different thread counts or corpora are kept separate. Reported ranges are observed extrema, not confidence intervals.
